decisions.reason: It builds on the firm's existing metal sectional door knowledge, so absorptive capacity allows learning from early results and lowers the chance of removal.
The insulated glazed door is still closely related to core door manufacturing, enabling the firm to assimilate thermal performance feedback and improve rather than drop it.
With dedicated page presentation and a direct fit with existing industrial door capabilities, the firm can interpret its market results and is very likely to keep investing.
